topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: Flowers without a card. Thing is, they’re beautiful. Roses, fresh, blood red. But it’s the silence that sticks, the weight of the space where words should be. I traced the stem, thinking, who sends such a thing and says nothing? Was it remorse or just the specter of it? Or maybe a way to say what can’t be said out loud. I half expected to find a message hidden, a clue. But nothing. Just these buds smiling at me, teasing with their innocence. I don’t buy it. Not for a second. So I let them sit there, talking to the walls, and went back to my thoughts, which are a lot quieter these days.
